crafter.help_message:
Welcome to the Crafter.

Send `list` to see every available craft, its materials and craft time.

Send an item name and amount, for example `Pistol 3`, to add it to your order.

Send `order` to view your current order.
Send `remove Pistol 2` to remove 2 from your order.
Send `confirm` to confirm and start it.
Send `clear` to empty your current order.
You can add or remove items before confirming.

groups.help_message:
Welcome to Groups.

Send `list` to see your groups.
Send `create <name>` to create a group.
Send `invite <group id> <player id>` to invite a player.
Send `accept <group id>` or `decline <group id>` to handle an invitation.
Send `members <group id>` to see the members.
Send `rename <group id> <name>` to rename a group.
Send `leave <group id>` to leave a group.
Send `remove <group id> <player id>` to remove a member.
Send `disband <group id>` to permanently delete a group.
